headline.caveat: >$500B combined target across all six financiers, subject to final agreements; no per-firm allocation disclosed

nature_md: Goldman Sachs is the only bank among the six financiers in NVIDIA's Aug 10, 2026 coalition targeting >$500B of third-party capital for compute-collateralized SPV financing. Goldman is simultaneously exposed to the AI-credit complex as underwriter and lender elsewhere: lead lender on SoftBank's $10B OpenAI-collateralized margin loan (Aug 2026), a lead arranger of SoftBank's $40B bridge, and a designated lender in the $38B Vantage/Oracle project-debt package. Per-firm commitments undisclosed; agreements are MOUs.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Prospective mix of client capital (Goldman Sachs Asset Management) and balance-sheet lending/structuring; as a bank holding company Goldman's principal exposures would carry regulatory capital charges — a reason most participation is likely distributed to clients. Nothing booked at MOU stage.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Target capitalization for platforms not yet funded; >$500B is aspirational pending final agreements.
